reduce_logs_with_custom_functions: reduce a nested log dictionary using custom JAX reduction functions for each metric type
reduce_logs_with_defaults: reduce a log dictionary using the default nanmean nanmin nanmax reduction functions
check_logs_rank_validation: validate that all log arrays in a nested dictionary have equal shapes and expected rank
use_reducetype_enum: use the ReduceType enum values MEAN MIN MAX NUM SUM NON_REDUCED to tag log metrics
access_reduce_functions_struct: access the REDUCE_FUNCTIONS struct to map ReduceType values to JAX numpy reduction functions
